title: Top Five Fan-Favorite Dishes at Noodles & Company
body_markdown:
# Top Five Fan-Favorite Dishes at Noodles & Company


As a company that has been in business for over 30 years, one thing is for certain – we know noodles. We are proud to have perfected the art of an expertly prepared and comforting menu that is built on flavorful variety. From classics such as the[Baked Chicken Parmesan](https://www.noodles.com/menu/chef-curated-with-protein/baked-chicken-parmesan) to Asian fusion dishes like the[Japanese Pan Noodles](https://www.noodles.com/menu/culinary-classics/japanese-pan-noodles) , we make sure that all guests with different palates and preferences can find something they enjoy.


While all the bowls on our menu hold a special place in our heart, there are some that are truly top tier. They deliver a feel-good experience for our guests and enable moments of comfort and connection. To highlight these special dishes, we have compiled a list of the top five Noodles & Company bowls that you, our loyal guests, come back for again and again. From cheesy to buttery, this list highlights all your favorites.


### 5.) Basil Pesto Cavatappi


Image


Dependable, one-of-a-kind and always sure to please, the[Basil Pesto Cavatappi](https://www.noodles.com/menu/culinary-classics/basil-pesto-cavatappi) starts our list off strong. This dish is best for the most responsible of people who always eat their vegetables but also enjoy a bit of zest in their meal. Perfectly craveable with a fresh, creamy and herby basil pesto sauce, this dish delivers deliciousness. Grape tomatoes along with roasted mushrooms infuse the bowl with earthy and natural flavors, while the finishing touches of parmesan cheese and Italian seasoning take it to a whole new level.


And we cannot forget that this bowl features the superior pasta shape: Cavatappi. This corkscrew-shaped noodle is designed to capture sauce while delivering the best texture. This isn’t your standard noodle, and it complements all the aspects of this bowl perfectly. If you haven’t tried Basil Pesto Cavatappi yet, what are you waiting for? Try it on your next visit!


Image


Image


### 4.) Crispy Chicken Bacon Alfredo


Image


Rich, approachable, and almost too good to be true, the[Crispy Chicken Bacon Alfredo](https://www.noodles.com/menu/chef-curated-with-protein/crispy-chicken-bacon-alfredo) earns the number four spot. It is an ideal choice for reformed picky eaters ready to explore more flavor while staying close to the comforting favorites they know. It features wide fettucine noodles that are enveloped in a luxurious four-cheese Alfredo sauce which incorporates the fan-favorite MontAmoré cheese (yes, we know you all miss the Alfredo MontAmoré!). The smoky bacon adds another layer of flavor to this bowl, and we suggest adding parmesan crusted chicken for a bit of crunch. To help balance the richness, broccoli and spinach are mixed into this delightful dish.


Crispy Chicken Bacon Alfredo is best for when you crave a dish that is cheesy and familiar but has an elevated taste. This is due in part to the MontAmoré cheese that is used in the sauce and is sprinkled on top as it is not commonly used ingredient. The depth of flavor it provides makes it stand out from other dishes and is the same as what we used in our original Alfredo bowl! This truly is a decadent delight that cannot be missed.


Image


Image


### 3.) Rigatoni Rosa with Parmesan Chicken


Image


Daring, bold and one of our original creations, the[Rigatoni Rosa with Parmesan Chicken](https://www.noodles.com/menu/chef-curated-with-protein/rigatoni-rosa-with-parmesan-chicken) is in third place. This dish is best for guests who enjoy more complex flavors and want to journey out of their comfort zone. This dish (formally lovingly referred to as the Penne Rosa), features a mildly spiced tomato cream sauce with a whole host of veggies, making it the perfect blend of hearty and flavorful. The bursting cherry tomatoes along with the spinach and mushrooms enhance the bowl with juicy, sweet flavors and makes this one of our most vegetable-packed dishes.


The Rigatoni Rosa does pack a bit of a punch in terms of spice, which makes it best for more adventurous foodies. Guests also have the choice to add either feta or parmesan to their bowl, which helps bring the heat down and is the best embellishment. Rigatoni noodles boost this dish with a more modern feel and are the ideal carrier for every element of the bowl. Make sure to add the parmesan chicken to make this a complete meal. Trust us, once you start eating the Rigatoni Rosa, you won’t be able to stop.


Image


Image


### 2.) Buttery Parmesan Noodles


Image


Comforting, simple, and always a crowd pleaser, the[Buttery Parmesan Noodles](https://www.noodles.com/menu/culinary-classics/buttery-parmesan-noodles) comes in at number two. This dish is best for guests of all ages and palates, from adults wanting a nostalgic meal to kids who need something familiar. It can be dressed up or enjoyed exactly as it is, making it one of the most versatile dishes on our menu.


What sets this bowl apart is that it is the perfect canvas to showcase our famous Italian Seasoning that only we offer. This blend features spices like black pepper, parsley, basil, rosemary, savory, oregano thyme, and garlic. However, its most surprising addition is lavender, which adds a floral element and enhances its simple flavor profile. This dish also features wavy egg noodles, which is the perfect vehicle for melted butter and parmesan cheese to come together. Sometimes you don’t need to mess with perfection, and that is what Buttery Parmesan Noodles are. Don’t hesitate to try this mainstay, there’s a reason it is number two!


Image


Image


### 1.) Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese


Image


Finally, at number one is our crown jewel: the[Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese](https://www.noodles.com/menu/mac-cheese/creamy-cheddar-mac-cheese) . This sparkling gem of a dish is crafted to create moments of connection and is the savior for those inevitably busy days. Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese is one of those magical dishes that truly makes your worries melt away under its gooey spell. It’s a simple formula, but it takes an expert to make right. Noodles & Company has always known noodles and there is not a dish we know better than Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese.


Unbelievably rich and creamy, the elbow noodles that are used easily capture the melted cheddar jack cheese sauce in its center, ensuring every bite is perfection. We don’t stop with just the sauce, as our signature mac is topped with an extra layer of shredded cheese, just in case it isn’t cheesy enough. The fact that our number one dish is a clear favorite is a testament to how we do the basics right. This is a dish you could make at home, but you won’t because you know how much better ours is. This menu staple will be here for you whenever you need it and is best enjoyed curled up on the couch. And if you want to spice it up, consider our[Buffalo Ranch Mac and Cheese](https://www.noodles.com/menu/mac-cheese/buffalo-chicken-ranch-mac-cheese) or our[BBQ Pulled Pork Mac and Cheese](https://www.noodles.com/menu/mac-cheese/pulled-pork-bbq-mac-cheese) . What are you waiting for? Place an order right now!
